request.query: Which countries have the most recruiting trials for type 2 diabetes?

visualization.title: Recruiting trials by country for type 2 diabetes
visualization.subtitle: 827 trials analyzed. Source: ClinicalTrials.gov

interpretation.rationale: A distribution by country shows which countries have the most recruiting trials for type 2 diabetes.

assumptions: A trial counts once per country it has at least one site in, so counts can sum to more than the number of trials.
Color scale is sequential (one hue, light to dark = fewer to more trials).
